{{Top|leg}}
'''Pressure Grip''' was a popular [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] accessory. The pressure grip would sense when the wielder was no longer holding the lightsaber and immediately deactivate the blade.<ref name="JATM">''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]''</ref>

Many Jedi incorporated the pressure grip into their lightsaber construction, as can be seen in the following instances. [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] dropped his lightsaber when he was impaled by [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], which deactivated. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] was disarmed when he was riding on top of [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell's]] air speeder on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. His lightsaber deactivated and then was caught by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. Obi-Wan Kenobi dropped his lightsaber when he was fighting General [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] on [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]], which deactivated and fell to the ground. It was found and returned to him by Clone Trooper Commander [[Cody/Legends|Cody]]. General Grievous's lightsabers likewise deactivated when he was disarmed by Obi-Wan Kenobi.
